queries.item: CREATE TABLE `?:talario_locations` (`location_id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `company_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `address` varchar(500) NOT NULL, `address_details` text NULL, `latitude` decimal(10,7) NULL, `longitude` decimal(10,7) NULL, `status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', `created_at` int unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`location_id`), KEY `company_status` (`company_id`,`status`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE `?:talario_resources` (`resource_id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `company_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', `created_at` int unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`resource_id`), KEY `company_status` (`company_id`,`status`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE `?:talario_resource_schedule_rules` (`rule_id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `resource_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `location_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `weekday` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL, `starts_time` time NOT NULL, `duration_minutes` smallint unsigned NOT NULL, `capacity` int unsigned NOT NULL, `valid_from` date NOT NULL, `valid_to` date NULL, `status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', PRIMARY KEY (`rule_id`), KEY `resource_status` (`resource_id`,`status`), KEY `location_id` (`location_id`), CONSTRAINT `fk_tsr_rule_resource` FOREIGN KEY (`resource_id`) REFERENCES `?:talario_resources` (`resource_id`), CONSTRAINT `fk_tsr_rule_location` FOREIGN KEY (`location_id`) REFERENCES `?:talario_locations` (`location_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE `?:talario_resource_products` (`product_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `resource_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`,`resource_id`), KEY `resource_product` (`resource_id`,`product_id`), CONSTRAINT `fk_tsr_product_resource` FOREIGN KEY (`resource_id`) REFERENCES `?:talario_resources` (`resource_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE `?:talario_resource_occurrences` (`occurrence_id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `resource_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `rule_id` int unsigned NULL, `location_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `starts_at` datetime NOT NULL, `ends_at` datetime NOT NULL, `capacity` int unsigned NOT NULL, `status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', `created_at` int unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`occurrence_id`), UNIQUE KEY `resource_start` (`resource_id`,`starts_at`), KEY `resource_status_start` (`resource_id`,`status`,`starts_at`), KEY `rule_id` (`rule_id`), KEY `location_id` (`location_id`), CONSTRAINT `fk_tsr_occ_resource` FOREIGN KEY (`resource_id`) REFERENCES `?:talario_resources` (`resource_id`), CONSTRAINT `fk_tsr_occ_rule` FOREIGN KEY (`rule_id`) REFERENCES `?:talario_resource_schedule_rules` (`rule_id`), CONSTRAINT `fk_tsr_occ_location` FOREIGN KEY (`location_id`) REFERENCES `?:talario_locations` (`location_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE `?:talario_resource_holds` (`hold_id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `occurrence_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `product_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `cart_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `cart_item_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `user_id` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `quantity` int unsigned NOT NULL, `status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', `expires_at` int unsigned NOT NULL, `created_at` int unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`hold_id`), UNIQUE KEY `cart_item` (`cart_id`,`cart_item_id`), KEY `occurrence_status_expiry` (`occurrence_id`,`status`,`expires_at`), CONSTRAINT `fk_tsr_hold_occ` FOREIGN KEY (`occurrence_id`) REFERENCES `?:talario_resource_occurrences` (`occurrence_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE `?:talario_resource_bookings` (`booking_id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `occurrence_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `product_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `order_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `order_item_id` int unsigned NOT NULL, `quantity` int unsigned NOT NULL, `status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', `created_at` int unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`booking_id`), UNIQUE KEY `order_item` (`order_id`,`order_item_id`), KEY `occurrence_status` (`occurrence_id`,`status`), CONSTRAINT `fk_tsr_booking_occ` FOREIGN KEY (`occurrence_id`) REFERENCES `?:talario_resource_occurrences` (`occurrence_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
